rule: Fixed q=1 and q=10 from prior two-flight work; no new-flight parameter selection. Native timestamps, no interpolation, no smoothing, first two rows excluded. Same observations for both settings.
aggregation: Mean of trial-level RMSE; equal window weighting within flights and equal flight weighting for macro summary.
interpretation: Recorded positions and relative altitude are references; all radar noise is synthetic. Noise-trial intervals do not represent population uncertainty. The eight additional flights were unseen by prior tuning.
